title: Nonnegativity of the failure indicator
statement: For a Boolean function $f:\\{-1,1\\}^n\\to\\{\\pm1\\}$, a nonnegative integer $k$, and a coordinate restriction $\\rho:[n]\\to\\{\\text{free},\\text{fixed }1,\\text{fixed }-1\\}$, the coordinate-switching failure indicator is nonnegative. Here the indicator equals $1$ when the decision-tree depth of the function obtained by applying $\\rho$ is at least $k$, and equals $0$ otherwise.
hypotheses_covered: Boolean function on the sign cube with values in {±1}
